suppressions.candidate: Secretariat could invoke the complete application-detail action directly.
suppressions.note: getApplicationDetail calls requireAuth, whose only implementation delegates to requireAdmin; a Secretariat session therefore fails before the broad relation query executes.

suppressions.candidate: Secretariat could obtain an applicant-evidence ticket by submitting a known storage path.
suppressions.note: getDocumentUrl uses the Administrator-only requireAuth boundary, while Secretariat document access is limited to the separate persisted-ID action.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat user could download an old issued-document version by guessing its persisted ID.
suppressions.note: For Secretaria, getIssuedDocumentUrl resolves the document server-side and compares its ID with getCurrentIssuedDocuments; that lookup also removes contracts for rejected applications and all documents for pending applications.

suppressions.candidate: The restricted applications UI could receive financial or applicant-evidence fields through a broad query.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria branch has an explicit applications columns allowlist and a students relation allowlist before data reaches the client.

suppressions.candidate: The restricted donor UI could receive CPF, address, CEP, or receipt metadata from donor_p_ledges.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria donor branch selects only the operational fields and omits CPF, address, CEP, receipt path, and receipt name at the database query boundary.

suppressions.candidate: A stale session could retain access after an account is deactivated or its role changes.
suppressions.note: requireStaff reads role and ativo from admin_users for each protected operation and rejects missing or inactive rows; session data is used only to identify the row.

suppressions.candidate: A public caller could mint an upload ticket with traversal or an arbitrary category/path.
suppressions.note: Category names are fixed or strictly indexed, filenames are sanitized and reject dot segments, and the signed path is generated by the server under pending/{uuid}; the storage driver separately enforces containment.
